purpose: Seamlessly connect two distinct camera positions through high-velocity directional motion blur.

required_visual_conditions: Continuity of motion direction (left-to-right or right-to-left across cut).
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> Transform1 (X Pan: 0.0 to -0.3) -> DirectionalBlur1 (Angle: 0, Length: 0.12) -> Dissolve1 into MediaIn2 with inverse pan -> MediaOut1
